description: Nijūbashi once more, now as pure street observation: a Japanese tour group in dark suits and dresses lines up for THEIR photo before the double-arched bridge and Fushimi-yagura; in the foreground an older man wears a white SURGICAL MASK under a grey cap (a sight that would have struck an American in 1965); a photographer in black crouches at left; the lamppost bisects the frame; families and pigeons along the moat rail at right.
setting: Tenth Japan frame — Larry photographing the Japanese photographing themselves; the collection's best people-watching frame from the trip.
questionsForLarry: What surprised you most about the Japanese crowds?
qualityNotes: Kodachrome slide, good light; lively documentary frame.
